title: Account Assistant - Temp
description:
Finance Reconciliation Officer

Temporary Contract Finance Department

Reporting to: Bursar
Department: Finance
Contract Type: Temporary

The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly organised and detail-oriented Finance Reconciliation Officer to support the Finance Department in an Independent School on a temporary basis. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced finance professional with strong Sage Accounting and advanced Excel skills who can confidently reconcile supplier and customer accounts, investigate discrepancies, and provide accurate financial reporting.

The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring financial records are accurate, fully supported, and presented clearly to the Bursar.

Key Responsibilities
- Reconcile supplier and customer accounts, ensuring balances are accurate and up to date.
- Review and investigate historical discrepancies, missing transactions, and outstanding balances.
- Collect and organise supporting documentation, including invoices, statements, payments, and credit notes.
- Identify and resolve aged balances, duplicate transactions, and unapplied payments.
- Use Sage Accounting to review transactions, analyse account balances, and extract reports.
- Prepare detailed reconciliation schedules and reports using Excel.
- Maintain accurate and organised audit trails for all reconciliations.
- Present findings and recommendations clearly to the Bursar.
- Escalate significant issues with proposed solutions where appropriate.

Essential Skills & Experience
- Strong practical experience using Sage Accounting Software.
- Advanced Excel skills, including:
- Pivot Tables
- VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP
- SUMIFS
- Data analysis and reporting
- Proven experience reconciling supplier and customer accounts.
- Strong understanding of:
- Purchase Ledger
- Sales Ledger
- Payments
- Credit Notes
- Account Balances
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.
- Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain financial information clearly.

Key Deliverables
- Fully reconciled supplier and customer account balances.
- Complete supporting documentation for all reconciliations.
- Clear records of discrepancies identified and actions taken.
- Summary reconciliation reports for the Bursar.
- Accurate financial records supported by a robust audit trail.

Apply Now

If you have strong Sage and Excel skills, excellent reconciliation experience, and enjoy resolving complex accounting discrepancies, we would like to hear from you.

Contact Muzna Naqvi at Reed Reading Office for more details

title: Credit Controller
description:
This well-established, reputable brand based in Bracknell are seeking a Credit Controller to join their team. You will be joining a growing organisation that offers career growth opportunities as well as a fantastic working culture. Furthermore, this role will be offered a hybrid working basis post completion of probation and will suit a progressive individual that has previous Credit Control experience and is now looking for a new challenge.

Job Title: Credit Controller

Job Type: Permanent, full time

Location: Bracknell, Berkshire

Salary: £28000 per annum

Reference no: 16192

Credit Controller Benefits
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
- Hybrid working- post probation
- Flexible working hours
- Car parking onsite
- Brilliant working culture

Credit Controller About The Role

In this role you will be reporting into the Finance Manager and will be working within a finance team of 8. You will be working alongside 1 other Credit Controller, and your key responsibilities will be:
- Updating cashbooks and reviewing foreign bank accounts for incoming funds
- Taking ownership of customer ledger and proactively managing outstanding balances
- Chasing outstanding debt, resolving queries, and initiating proceedings where required
- Reconciling key customer and national accounts, raising discrepancies with internal teams
- Producing regular reports and invoices including uploading to customer portals
- Preparing consolidated reports, customer statements, and month-end information for the Finance Controller
- Managing credit balances, debit notes, back orders, and exchange rate updates
- Support with other relevant finance & admin duties as required

The successful Credit Controller will have:
- Previous experience with Credit Control duties
- Ability to communicate at all levels
- Strong organisational skills

title: Junior Finance & Operations Assistant
description:
Junior Finance & Business Operations Assistant

Location: Aldermaston, Berkshire UK Salary: 27,000

This Junior Finance & Business Operations Assistant role is ideal for someone looking to develop a long-term career in finance, with hands-on experience across sales ledger, purchase ledger, credit control, and wider business operations.

The successful candidate will be organised, hardworking, and detail-oriented, with a proactive approach and a willingness to learn. This role offers the opportunity to develop practical finance skills, gain exposure to business operations, and progress towards a more senior or management position over time.

Key Responsibilities
- Finance Administration: Provide day-to-day support to the finance function, maintaining accurate financial records and assisting with reporting, reconciliations, and general finance administration.
- Sales Ledger: Assist with raising sales invoices, allocating customer payments, monitoring outstanding balances, and supporting credit control activities.
- Purchase Ledger: Process supplier invoices, check and reconcile supplier statements, maintain accurate purchase ledger records, and assist with supplier payment processes.
- Credit Control: Help monitor overdue accounts, follow up outstanding payments, and support the maintenance of healthy customer accounts.
- Business Operations & HR Support: Support HR and administrative activities, including employee record-keeping, recruitment coordination, document preparation, and coordination across business functions.

Key Requirements
- A degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related subject would be advantageous.
- An AAT Level 2 qualification, or willingness to work towards one, would be beneficial.
- Strong English and Maths skills, ideally with GCSE grades of 6 or above.
- A hardworking, reliable attitude and a genuine willingness to learn.
- An interest in developing a long-term career in finance and business operations.
- Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively with colleagues, customers, and suppliers.

Career Development

This is an excellent opportunity for someone at the start of their career to gain practical experience across core finance functions, particularly sales and purchase ledger, credit control, and business operations. With training, experience, and continued development, there is potential to progress into a more senior finance position or management role in the future.

To apply for this Junior Finance & Business Operations Assistant role based in Aldermaston, Berkshire, please send your CV to (url removed) or call (phone number removed).

title: Part-Time Finance Administrator
description:
Part-Time Finance Administrator - Flexible Hours

Are you an experienced finance professional looking for a part-time role that offers flexibility, a friendly working environment and a good work-life balance? We're working with an established engineering business looking for a reliable, hands-on Part-Time Finance Administrator to join their small, friendly team. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys getting involved in the day-to-day finances of a business, likes a bit of banter and wants to work in a relaxed but professional environment.

The Role

You'll play an important part in keeping the company's finances running smoothly, with responsibilities including:

Preparing and updating weekly cash flow forecasts.

Managing month-end financial processes.

Preparing the year-end trial balance for the external accountant.

Preparing and submitting VAT returns.

Maintaining accurate financial records using Sage.

Providing general finance and accounts support.

No payroll or sales invoicing responsibilities - the focus is on core finance and keeping the numbers in good shape.

What We're Looking For

Previous experience in a finance or accounts role.

Good working knowledge of Sage 50

Experience with VAT returns, month-end and year-end processes.

Confidence preparing cash flow forecasts.

Someone organised, reliable and comfortable working independently.

A friendly, down-to-earth personality who enjoys working as part of a small team.

The Working Environment

You'll be joining a small engineering business where everyone works closely together. The environment is practical, friendly and informal, with plenty of good banter along the way!

They're looking for someone who will fit into the team, get on with the job and bring a positive, professional attitude.

Hours & Flexibility

Approximately 3-4 days per week.

Around 5 hours per day, ideally 15-20 hours per week.

Flexibility to discuss a working pattern that works for both you and the business.

Salary dependent on experience

title: Payroll Administrator
description:

We want you to bring your authentic self to work, giving you the space to be yourself, whether that is creative, outgoing, quiet, courageous, observant, or any other attributes you may have. - Support Bureau Services: Utilise your expertise to handle high-volume, multi-client payrolls efficiently.
- Optimise Customer Solutions: Identify ways to streamline workflows and address our clients' needs very precisely.
- Ensure Compliance: Maintain strict adherence to UK legislation, ensuring all data remains secure and accurate.

- On-Site Commitment: Ability to work from our office 3 days per week.

- 30 days annual leave plus bank holidays
